name: Lee's Hoagie House
description: A Horsham hoagie shop serving made-to-order hoagies and sandwiches.

hero.headline: Lee's Hoagie House
hero.sub: Made-to-order hoagies and sandwiches, built the way Montgomery County likes them.

items: Classic and specialty hoagies made to order
Sandwich platters for group and office orders
Sides and drinks to round out an order
Serving the Horsham and Montgomery County area
Platters available for offices and groups
A neighborhood shop, not a chain

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Lee’s Hoagie House has stuck to one thing: making a hoagie to order instead of pre-building them for a case.
The menu stays focused on classic hoagie combinations, built the way regulars expect them.

items: Orders are built fresh when they come in, not assembled ahead of time.
Platter orders can be arranged for offices and groups.
Regulars can call ahead to skip the wait at pickup.

feature.heading: Made to order, every time
feature.text: Nothing sits pre-built in a case -- every hoagie is built after the order comes in.

spotlight.heading: Platters for the whole office
spotlight.text: Group and office orders get the same made-to-order approach, just scaled up.
